payout_quote: America 250 Bonus Offer - Terms & Disclosures. Offer Period: Valid July 6, 2026 through December 31, 2026. Bonus Requirements: To qualify for the $250 bonus, the following requirements must be completed: Open a new qualifying Alero Plus or Fusion Plus consumer checking account during the offer period; Enroll in eStatements within 30 calendar days of account opening; Receive cumulative qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $2,500 within 90 calendar days of account opening; Complete a minimum of 15 qualifying debit card purchase transactions within 90 calendar days of account opening. Bonus Payment: The $250 bonus will be deposited into the new qualifying Alero Plus or Fusion Plus consumer checking account within 45 calendar days after all promotional requirements have been met and verified. The account must be open and in good standing at the time of bonus payment. Additional Disclosures: Bonus may be reported as interest or income to the Internal Revenue Service, and the recipient is responsible for any applicable taxes. Offer may not be combined with other checking account promotions.
steps: Open a new qualifying Alero Plus or Fusion Plus consumer checking account during the offer period (July 6 - December 31, 2026).

Complete at least 15 qualifying debit card purchase transactions within 90 calendar days of account opening.
catches: Available to new members and existing members who do NOT currently have an open consumer checking account; existing checking holders (even opening an additional account) are not eligible.

Requires $2,500 in cumulative qualifying direct deposits within 90 days - a high deposit bar. Qualifying direct deposits are recurring ACH deposits from an employer, payroll provider, pension administrator, or government benefits provider; transfers between accounts, person-to-person payments (including Zelle), mobile check deposits, ATM deposits, and internal transfers do NOT qualify.

Requires 15 qualifying debit card purchases within 90 days; only point-of-sale purchase transactions count - ATM withdrawals, cash advances, refunds, reversals, and disputed transactions do not qualify.
Limit one bonus per member, taxpayer identification number, and household; employees, volunteers, officials, and directors not eligible.
$250 bonus deposited into the new account within 45 calendar days after all requirements have been met and verified; account must be open and in good standing at bonus payment time.
Illinois-headquartered credit union (formerly Corporate America Family CU) with branches across the Midwest and California; membership eligibility requirements apply - confirm on alerofinancial.org.
Official disclosure: 'Bonus may be reported as interest or income to the Internal Revenue Service, and the recipient is responsible for any applicable taxes.'
Offer may not be combined with other checking account promotions; Alero reserves the right to modify or discontinue the offer.
biggest_catch: $2,500 in qualifying direct deposits within 90 days plus 15 debit card purchases - one of the higher deposit bars among current bonus offers.
eligibility: New Alero Financial members, and existing members without an open consumer checking account, who open a new Alero Plus or Fusion Plus consumer checking account during the offer period (July 6 - December 31, 2026). Illinois-headquartered credit union; membership eligibility requirements apply.
timing: $250 deposited into the new qualifying account within 45 calendar days after all promotional requirements have been met and verified; account must be open and in good standing at the time of bonus payment.
